rules.name: standalone-components
rules.howToFix: Remove `standalone: false` (standalone is the default in Angular 20) and import dependencies via `imports`.

source.text: All components are standalone and use `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`.

rules.name: onpush
rules.message: Components must use OnPush change detection.
rules.howToFix: Add `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` to the @Component decorator and import ChangeDetectionStrategy from @angular/core.

source.text: All components are standalone and use `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`.

rules.name: inject-function
rules.message: Dependencies must be injected with inject(), not constructor parameters.
rules.howToFix: Replace the constructor parameter with `private readonly dep = inject(Dep);` as a field.

source.text: Use the `inject()` function for dependencies, never constructor parameter injection.

rules.name: no-any
rules.howToFix: Use a real type, or `unknown` and narrow it with a type guard.

source.text: Never use `any`. Use `unknown` and narrow it.

rules.name: no-httpclient-in-components
rules.message: Components must not use HttpClient directly.
rules.howToFix: Move the request into a service (features/<feature>/services/ or core/) and inject that service.

source.text: Components never call `HttpClient` directly; data access goes through services.

rules.name: no-console-log
rules.howToFix: Remove the call, or surface the information through the UI or a proper error handler.

rules.name: services-placement
rules.message: Services belong in core/ (app-wide) or features/<feature>/services/.

source.text: Feature services live in `features/<feature>/services/`; app-wide services in `core/`.

rules.name: models-placement
rules.message: Models belong in features/<feature>/models/ or core/models/.

source.text: Models (interfaces) live in a `models/` folder of their feature or in `core/models`.
Keep pull requests small and focused.
Ask before adding a new npm dependency.
